recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any desire to make http://hl7.org/fhir/ndfrt resolve again should be handled as web redirect or terminology hosting follow-up, not as a current FHIR core source correction for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-6034 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction reporting that the Known Systems / Code Systems table linked NDF-RT through http://hl7.org/fhir/ndfrt and that URL returned 404.
initial_application: The issue was applied in Subversion revision 5524, visible in git as e62110a2d2ffe726d9ac4e7be253c5d01b8e0d7c, which changed source/terminologies-systems.html from the broken hl7.org/fhir/ndfrt href to an NLM UMLS NDFRT URL.
additional_context: Later published terminology work changed the same table: FHIR-35800 updated NDF-RT guidance and added MED-RT replacement context, then FHIR-39156 removed the NDF-RT row because NDF-RT is no longer maintained and MED-RT replaced it. The active current Code Systems page is source/terminologies-systems.html via source/hierarchy.xml, and the only remaining NDF-RT page link found under source/ points to the THO NDFRT page.
reconciliation: No source files were edited. Current source/terminologies-systems.html lists MED-RT rather than the old NDF-RT row, rg found no http://hl7.org/fhir/ndfrt occurrence under source/, and https://terminology.hl7.org/NDFRT.html resolves successfully.
